notes.title: VPN split tunnelling drops file-share mounts
notes.body: When split tunnelling is enabled, traffic to the 10.20.0.0/16 range is routed outside the tunnel and mounted file shares disconnect after roughly ninety seconds of idle time. Disable split tunnelling in the client profile, or add 10.20.0.0/16 to the include list. Reconnecting the client does not persist the change; the profile must be edited.

notes.title: Laptop refuses the VPN certificate after a hardware swap
notes.body: The device certificate is bound to the machine identifier, so a replacement mainboard invalidates it. The client reports 'certificate not yet valid' regardless of the actual dates. Re-enrol the device from the self-service portal; a manual certificate copy will appear to work and will fail again at the next renewal.

notes.title: Print queue stalls when a job is submitted while the spooler is restarting
notes.body: A job submitted during a spooler restart lands in the queue without an owner and blocks everything behind it. Clearing the queue from the printer's own panel does not remove it. Cancel the ownerless job from the print server, then restart the spooler once more.

notes.title: Shared mailbox stops receiving after a licence change
notes.body: Removing a licence from the account that owns a shared mailbox suspends delivery silently; senders receive no bounce for the first twenty-four hours. Reassign a licence to the owning account and delivery resumes, but the messages held during the silent window are not replayed and must be resent.

notes.title: Two-factor prompts loop on a device whose clock has drifted
notes.body: Time-based codes fail when the device clock is more than thirty seconds from the server, and the portal reports the generic 'code not recognised' rather than a clock error. Enable automatic time synchronisation on the device. A code that is retyped quickly enough to appear valid will still be rejected.

vpn.note: Split tunnelling issue under investigation. Gateway itself is up.
